scripts.sim:A: node sim/run.js v29 100 1000 results/stageE_v29_A.json A on on off spec on
scripts.sim:A:legacy: node sim/run.js legacy 100 1000 results/stageE_legacy_A.json A on on off spec on
scripts.sim:R: node sim/run.js v29 100 1000 results/stageE_v29_R.json R on on off spec on
scripts.sim:initiative: for v in spec none reserve2 card breath spark; do node sim/run.js v29 70 5000 results/stageD_init_$v.json R on on off $v on; done
scripts.sim:market:off: node sim/run.js v29 70 5000 results/stageD_market_off.json R on on off spec off
scripts.report: node sim/report.js results/stageE_v29_E.json results/stageE_v29_A.json results/stageE_legacy_A.json results/stageE_v29_R.json
scripts.sim:E: node sim/run.js v29 100 1000 results/stageE_v29_E.json E on on on spec on
scripts.sim:market:diag: for v in spec norefresh p2refresh from2 nobuy; do WA_MKT=$v node sim/run.js v29 40 5000 results/stageD_diag_$v.json R on on off spec on; done
